title: 第九章 抢宝

content_zh:
“太好了，突破到了第五重，又有了五虎之力再加上八响的奔雷手，到时候，第六重的高手都能打爆，简直是有了突飞猛进的突破！”叶希文欣喜的说道，
后天九重，每一重都相差极大，初入后天五重不过是两虎之力，但是后天六重却是有五虎之力，超过两千五百斤！
光就战斗力而言，拥有打爆第六重的高手的实力的叶希文在内门弟子中都能排的上一流了，不过要想晋升成为核心弟子，这还不够。
除非叶希文能突破到后天六重，到时候就有相当的希望能够晋升进核心弟子。
顺利突破到五虎之力，叶希文随手打出一拳，都能震荡空气，比起之前更是天差地别。
不过虽然实力飞速提升，但是代价也是大的很，地心果已经完全被消化干净了，连那四十块的灵石也都为了推演奔雷手的最后一响，而消耗殆尽，比起之前推演八响消耗都还要大的多了。
当然奔雷手第八响推演出来之后，奔雷手的威力也是不可同日而语，一举达到了中级功法的威力。
要想让实力在短时间内突飞猛进，无论是为了推演武学，还是境界的进步，都离不开灵石，地心果之类的天材地宝，毕竟可遇而不可求，目前最稳妥的办法，就是猎杀妖兽，然后换成晶石，还可以增加战斗经验，一举几得。
打定了主意之后，叶希文迅速离开了一元宗驻地，往青峰山深处而去。
——————————————————————————
时间一天天的过去，叶希文已经在青峰山中呆了三天的时间了叶希文已经进入了青峰山颇为深处了，现在可以看到一些后天五重，甚至是后天六重的妖兽出没。
昨天叶希文就碰到了一头后天六重巅峰妖兽，险些丧命在那头妖兽的口中。
当时真是命悬一线，叶希文至此也是深感，没有兵器确实有很多的不便，和人对决的时候还好，但是和这些妖兽对决的时候，就到处吃亏了，手到底是不能和妖兽的爪牙相比的。
这一天，叶希文穿越了一片峡谷，在一片峭壁之上，发现了一株血色的人参，叶希文曾经在一本杂记上看到过这种血色的人参，是人参中的变种，一般的人参都有增加人的功力的功效，但是这种血色的人参更是一般人参的好几倍。
看这赤血参的外貌，起码也是超过了一百年火候的灵果了，如果能服下这赤血参，叶希文起码能直接突破到后天六重，到时候叶希文就稳稳的可以晋升核心弟子了，看到时候还有谁敢小看他。
叶希文不再犹豫，连忙攀爬了上去，动作灵活无比，犹如一只灵猿，很快就爬到了赤血参所在的位置。
叶希文摊开大手，一把朝赤血参抓去。
“嘭！”叶希文只抓下一把泥土，却没抓到赤血参，抬头一看，赤血参居然出现在了离这里百米开外的地方。
“这棵赤血参居然有了朦朦胧胧的意识！”叶希文大为惊讶，这天地之间，万物有灵，就算是一块顽石，经过了亿万年的时间也未必没有得道的希望，人参这样的天材地宝，更是集齐了天地的精华，千年的参王就能产生朦朦胧胧的意识，一般人就算发现了也抓不到，人参天生就有土系神通，甚至有必要的话，可以日行数百里，如果参王能有万年的火候，甚至能化为人形，成为山间的精灵。
而这棵赤血参果然不愧是变异了的人参，不过是百年火候，居然已经能产生朦朦胧胧的潜意识了，看来只怕不用千年就能化形了，不过既然被也叶希文看到了，自然不会放过。

叶希文全身一起劲，真气爆裂开，叶希文的的身躯顿时飞掠起来，在半空中犹如一只捕食的大鹰朝着那一株赤血参扑去。
“嘭！”叶希文抓进了峭壁中，一把将赤血参抓到手里，赤血参都来不及逃走就被叶希文一把拽出了峭壁之中，离开了土，赤血参的朦朦胧胧的土系神通也都没用了。
叶希文脸上露出微笑，爬下峭壁正要找个僻静的地方吞服，突然一声爆喝从身后传来。
“交出赤血参！”
叶希文转头一看，却见三个年轻人一脸冷漠的看着他。
这三个年轻人其中两个约莫着二十多岁，分别身着青衣和紫衣，而中间一个少年约莫着十七八岁，一身白袍，和叶希文年纪差不多，一脸傲气，发出声音的却是那个青衣的青年。

"Great, we have broken through to the fifth level, and with the power of the Five Tigers and the eight-ring thunder hand, by then, the masters of the sixth level will be able to defeat them. It is a breakthrough by leaps and bounds!" Ye Xiwen said happily,
Each level of the acquired ninth level is very different. When you first enter the acquired fifth level, you only have the power of two tigers, but the acquired sixth level has the power of five tigers, more than 2,500 kilograms!
In terms of combat power alone, Ye Xiwen, who has the ability to defeat sixth-level masters, is ranked first among the inner disciples, but this is not enough to be promoted to a core disciple.
Unless Ye Xiwen can break through to the acquired sixth level, there is considerable hope that he can be promoted to a core disciple.
After successfully breaking through to the power of the Five Tigers, Ye Xiwen could easily shake the air with a punch, which was completely different from before.
However, although the strength has increased rapidly, the price is also very high. The core fruit has been completely digested, and even the forty pieces of spiritual stones have been exhausted in order to deduce the last sound of the thunder hand, which is much greater than the previous deduction of the eight sounds.
Of course, after the eighth ring of the Thunderbolt Hand was deduced, the power of the Thunderbolt Hand was also different, reaching the power of the intermediate skill in one fell swoop.
If you want to make a rapid improvement in strength in a short period of time, whether it is for the purpose of martial arts or for the advancement of realm, you cannot do without spiritual stones, earth core fruits and other heavenly materials and treasures. After all, they can be encountered but cannot be obtained. The safest way at present is to hunt monsters and then replace them with crystal stones. It can also increase combat experience and gain multiple benefits with one stone.
After making up his mind, Ye Xiwen quickly left the Yiyuanzong station and headed deep into Qingfeng Mountain.
————————————————————————
Time passed day by day, and Ye Xiwen had stayed in Qingfeng Mountain for three days. Ye Xiwen had entered quite deep into Qingfeng Mountain, and now he could see some acquired fifth-level, and even acquired sixth-level monsters.
Yesterday, Ye Xiwen encountered a sixth-level acquired monster, and almost died in the monster's mouth.
At that time, his life was really hanging by a thread. Ye Xiwen also felt deeply that it was really inconvenient to have no weapons. It was fine when fighting against people, but when fighting against these monsters, he suffered losses everywhere. After all, his hands could not compare with the minions of monsters.
On this day, Ye Xiwen passed through a canyon and found a blood-colored ginseng on a cliff. Ye Xiwen had seen this kind of blood-colored ginseng in a journal. It was a variant of ginseng. Generally, ginseng has the effect of increasing people's power, but this kind of blood-colored ginseng is several times stronger than ordinary ginseng.
Judging from the appearance of this red blood ginseng, it is at least a spiritual fruit that has been heated for more than a hundred years. If he can take this red blood ginseng, Ye Xiwen can at least directly break through to the sixth level of the day after tomorrow. By then, Ye Xiwen will be able to be promoted to a core disciple. Who dares to look down on him when he sees it.
Ye Xiwen no longer hesitated and quickly climbed up. His movements were extremely flexible, like a spiritual ape, and he quickly climbed to the location of the red blood ginseng.
Ye Xiwen spread out his big hand and grabbed the red blood ginseng.
"Bang!" Ye Xiwen only grabbed a handful of dirt, but failed to catch the red blood ginseng. When he looked up, the red blood ginseng actually appeared a hundred meters away from here.
"This red ginseng tree actually has a hazy consciousness!" Ye Xiwen was greatly surprised. In this world, everything has animism. Even a stubborn stone may not have no hope of enlightenment after hundreds of millions of years. Ginseng, a treasure of heaven and earth, has gathered the essence of heaven and earth. , a thousand-year-old ginseng king can produce a hazy consciousness, which ordinary people cannot catch even if they find it. Ginseng is born with earth magical powers, and it can even travel hundreds of miles a day if necessary. If the ginseng king can have ten thousand years of fire, it can even transform into a human form and become a mountain spirit.
And this red blood treeThe ginseng is indeed a mutated ginseng. It has only been heated for a hundred years, but it can actually produce a hazy subconscious. It seems that it will take less than a thousand years to transform, but since Ye Xiwen saw it, he will not let it go.
Ye Xiwen's whole body was full of energy, and his true energy exploded. Ye Xiwen's body suddenly flew up, like a large predatory eagle in mid-air, and pounced towards the red blood ginseng.
"Bang!" Ye Xiwen grabbed into the cliff and grabbed the red blood ginseng in his hand. Before the red blood ginseng could escape, Ye Xiwen pulled him out of the cliff and left the soil. The hazy earth magic power of the red blood ginseng was useless.
With a smile on his face, Ye Xiwen climbed down the cliff and was about to find a secluded place to swallow when suddenly a loud shout came from behind.
"Hand over the red blood ginseng!"
Ye Xiwen turned around and saw three young people looking at him with indifferent expressions.
Two of the three young men were about 20 years old, and were dressed in green and purple respectively. The middle boy was about seventeen or eighteen years old, wearing a white robe, about the same age as Ye Xiwen, with an arrogant look on his face, but it was the young man in green who made the sound.
